description: DefaultStrings:329 -- two tiebreaker language codes that CANONICALIZE to the same code. 'mo' and 'ro' are a CLDR alias pair, not a JDK legacy pair: Locale.Builder leaves 'mo' as 'mo', so only CLDR normalization collapses them, and a port applying the JDK's own he->iw mapping and nothing else accepts this input. The keys are in SORTED order deliberately: the built artifact is RFC 8785 canonical JSON, so a consumer reading it never sees the order they were authored in, and Java's diagnostic names whichever supplied code it met FIRST.
